import ssl,http.client,json
from pathlib import Path
import psycopg,pytest
import tests.integration.test_server_tls as tls
pytest_plugins=['tests.integration.conftest']
def test_real_validating_tls_oversized_browser_and_revoke_are_client_errors(ledger,dsn,tmp_path,monkeypatch):
 observations=[];done=[]
 def request(port,method,path,body=None,headers=None):
  context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(tmp_path/'tls-cert.pem'));assert context.check_hostname and context.verify_mode==ssl.CERT_REQUIRED
  def send(method,path,body,headers):
   c=http.client.HTTPSConnection('localhost',port,context=context,timeout=10)
   try:
    c.request(method,path,body=body,headers=headers or {});r=c.getresponse();return r.status,{k.lower():v for k,v in r.getheaders()},r.read()
   finally:c.close()
  if not done:
   done.append(True)
   for endpoint,ctype in [('/ag/login','application/x-www-form-urlencoded'),('/ag/consent','application/x-www-form-urlencoded'),('/ag/tasks/task-001/revoke','application/json'),('/oauth/token','application/x-www-form-urlencoded')]:
    status,_,_=send('POST',endpoint,b'a'*65537,{'Content-Type':ctype});observations.append({'endpoint':endpoint,'bytes':65537,'status':status})
   with psycopg.connect(dsn) as c:
    assert c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM ag_authorization_codes').fetchone()==(0,);assert c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM ag_operations').fetchone()==(0,);assert c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM ag_auth_events').fetchone()==(0,)
  return send(method,path,body,headers)
 monkeypatch.setattr(tls,'_request',request);tls.test_tls_server_runs_the_full_as_flow(ledger,dsn,tmp_path)
 Path('/evidence/logs/http-bounds-observations.json').write_text(json.dumps(observations,indent=2));assert all(400<=x['status']<500 for x in observations),observations
